description: List the files changed by a GitLab merge request, including available patch content. Results are paginated, with up to 100 changed files per page; unified diff format can be requested. GitLab may omit diff content because of its diff limits.

merge_request_iid.description: The internal ID of the merge request.
merge_request_iid.title: Merge Request Iid

page.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of changed files per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
per_page.title: Per Page

project_id.description: The numeric ID or namespace path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

unidiff.description: If true, return each change in unified diff format.
unidiff.title: Unidiff

name: list_merge_request_diffs

changed_files.description: Changed files in the requested page of merge request diffs.
changed_files.title: Changed Files

next_page.description: Next page number, if another page exists.
next_page.title: Next Page

prev_page.description: Previous page number, if a previous page exists.
prev_page.title: Prev Page

collapsed.description: Whether the diff was omitted but can be fetched separately.
collapsed.title: Collapsed

diff.description: Textual diff, unless GitLab omitted it due to diff limits.
diff.title: Diff

generated_file.description: Whether GitLab identifies the file as generated.
generated_file.title: Generated File

new_path.description: Path of the file after the change.
new_path.title: New Path

old_path.description: Path of the file before the change.
old_path.title: Old Path

too_large.description: Whether the diff was omitted because it exceeds size limits.
too_large.title: Too Large
